notes: Prism 2.9.2: a dropped connection no longer takes your dictation with it. If your network faltered part-way through a long dictation, Prism pasted only the words it had heard before the drop and quietly discarded the rest — no warning, and nothing left on the clipboard to recover. It had the whole recording in hand the entire time and was not using it. Now it notices when it has missed anything and falls back to the complete recording, so you get everything you said. Short bursts on a good connection are unchanged: the fast path still handles those. Your audio is never stored. Free.
